title: [Shortcut Guide] Default "Hold Windows key" behavior interferes with Win+V and Win+H

status.label: Reproduced and maintainer-owned
status.detail: The issue is assigned to noraa-junker, marked reproducible, and has a maintainer analysis of the foreground-window interaction.

next_action.label: Post product-direction summary
next_action.reason: The remaining decision is how Shortcut Guide should behave when another Windows-key feature is already active.

comment.body: The reproduction is confirmed and this issue is assigned. The current maintainer analysis is that Clipboard History and voice typing close when their foreground state changes as Shortcut Guide's hold behavior activates. Before implementation, maintainers should choose the intended product behavior: suppress hold activation after another Win-key chord is recognized, change the default hold behavior, or document the limitation. That decision should stay in this issue so a fix does not unintentionally change other Shortcut Guide activation paths.

judgment.rationale: The report is reproducible and has both an assignee and current maintainer analysis, so parallel dashboard investigation would duplicate active upstream handling.
evidence: The issue is assigned to maintainer noraa-junker.
The latest maintainer comment says Win+V and Win+H close when foreground changes as Shortcut Guide closes.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a concise direction summary that keeps the behavioral choice with the assigned maintainers.
